Name: Water and Tree Lanterns
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds 6 new lanterns that you can place on water or trees.

These lanterns have day and night textures and will work like lamps at night.

You can buy the recipes from Robin and the decoration boat from the Night Market.

[b]PSA: Make sure to update Machine Terrain Framework to the latest version, because it fixes a bug with stuck lights.
[/b]
